name: Create Populator
description: Create the PanelPopulator that builds a panel as a panel type: the type's layers, agents, detail sets and settings. The panel goes into CT: Model as it is; CT: Populate Model gives it the type's layers before the panel joints and population run.

inputParameters.name: panel
inputParameters.description: Panel element, e.g. from CT: Panel: the same panel that goes into CT: Model.

inputParameters.name: panel_type
inputParameters.description: PanelType from CT: Stud Wall Panel Type, CT: Custom Panel Type or CT: Panel Type From JSON. The panel must be as thick as a type with a fixed thickness.

outputParameters.name: populator
outputParameters.description: PanelPopulator. Connect to CT: Populate Model.
